facts.claim: The council's provider guide (v2.1, Sept 2026) quotes the 2026 VisitScotland Guidance: the levy should be included as turnover and, if the provider is VAT-registered, is liable for VAT; the levy applies to providers below the VAT threshold too. So at a VAT-registered hotel the levy plus its VAT equals 5% of the VAT-inclusive room price (editorial arithmetic: £180 incl. VAT -> £150 net -> £7.50 levy + £1.50 VAT = £9/night; £27 for 3 nights; £45 for a 7-night stay).
